Deliver a planning-store story: implement it, verify the current implementation revision with its tests and the repository's gate, open a pull request for it, read its continuous integration, and merge it under authority. Accepted once the pull request is merged, or abandoned on an explicit decision. Every claim is about the implementation at its current revision, so a new commit returns all of them to unknown. A case fixes whether the tests must fail before the implementation is edited and whether the gate runs once, after the handover, or at every revision; the pull request opens only on a complete change, with test paths and implementation paths both changed and the tests and the gate green at one revision.

- **Id:** `story.delivery`
- **Revision:** 2
- **Source:** [`protocols/story-delivery/2.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/engineering-protocols/blob/main/protocols/story-delivery/2.yaml)

## Dependency graph

Which actions may produce which evidence, which claims that evidence establishes, and which outcomes and obligations rest on those claims. Hover or focus a node to trace what it rests on.

<ProtocolGraph data={graph} />

## Actions

What can be done in a case: what it needs first, which authority it requires, the class of effect it has and the evidence it may produce.

| Action | Description | Precondition | Requires capability | Effect | May produce |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `change.handover` | hand the change over, changing no file, once it is complete (the story's tests written and the implementation done) and no further edit is needed; takt records the choice, and the pull request is opened for this revision and its continuous integration read once | `change.handed_over` is **UNKNOWN** | *no authority* | `read` | `handover` |
| `change.read` | read whether merging the implementation revision into the base branch's tip would change its tree outside .engineering/, and which paths it changes; taken once the change is handed over | `change.handed_over` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `read` | `change_record`, `paths_changed` |
| `ci.read` | read the continuous integration result for the pull request's head; needs the pull request open for the implementation revision | `pr.opened` is **TRUE** | *no authority* | `read` | `ci_result` |
| `gate.run` | run the repository's gate against an implementation revision; when the case runs the gate after the handover, needs the tests passing and the change handed over at the revision | any of (all of (`change.handed_over` is **TRUE**; `tests.pass` is **TRUE**); input `gate_on` is one of `each_revision`) | *no authority* | `read` | `gate_result` |
| `implementation.edit` | change the implementation in the repository's working revision; when the case requires its tests first, needs the story's tests written and failing at the current revision, or written and passing there with the gate or continuous integration failed there, so a failure no test reads (formatting, lint, another platform) can be fixed | any of (all of (any of (`ci.green` is **FALSE**; `gate.green` is **FALSE**); `tests.pass` is **TRUE**; not (the first `tests_change` about `implementation` is `none`)); `tests.shown_red` is **TRUE**; input `tests_first` is one of `optional`) | *no authority* | `write` | *no evidence* |
| `pr.open` | push the implementation revision, with the commits that record its approval above it when there are any, and open its pull request through the repository's bot route; needs the tests and the gate green, the change handed over at the revision, a merge of it into the base branch's tip that would change the tip outside .engineering/, so nothing is opened at the seed or for content the base already has, and the change complete, so it opens once, on a revision with both test paths and implementation paths changed | all of (`change.complete` is **TRUE**; `change.handed_over` is **TRUE**; `change.made` is **TRUE**; `gate.green` is **TRUE**; `tests.pass` is **TRUE**) | *no authority* | `write` | `pull_request` |
| `repository.inspect` | read the repository | *none* | *no authority* | `read` | *no evidence* |
| `repository.merge` | merge the pull request into the repository's mainline; needs continuous integration green, the pull request open and authority to merge, never only a connection to the repository host | all of (`ci.green` is **TRUE**; `pr.opened` is **TRUE**) | `repository.merge` | `write` | `merge_observation` |
| `tests.run` | run the tests against an implementation revision | *none* | *no authority* | `read` | `test_result` |
| `tests.write` | change the tests in the repository's working revision | *none* | *no authority* | `write` | `tests_change` |

## Evidence kinds

The kinds of evidence this protocol admits.

| Evidence kind | Description | Produced by | Used by claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| `change_record` | whether merging an implementation revision into the base branch's tip would change that tip's tree outside .engineering/; its result is ahead or none | `change.read` | `change.made` |
| `ci_result` | the result of continuous integration on an implementation revision; its result is pass or fail | `ci.read` | `ci.green` |
| `gate_result` | the result of the repository's gate against an implementation revision; its result is pass or fail | `gate.run` | `gate.green` |
| `handover` | the harness chose to hand the change over at this implementation revision, with no file changed: takt records the choice from the step, as it records a request for an approval. The record attests a choice, not that the change is correct: the tests, the gate and continuous integration stay validator evidence; it has no result | `change.handover` | `change.handed_over` |
| `merge_observation` | the observation that the pull request whose head is an implementation revision, or that revision with only the commits that record its approval above it, was merged; its result is merged | `repository.merge` | `pr.merged` |
| `paths_changed` | which paths an implementation revision changes since the base branch's tip: test paths, implementation paths, both or neither; its result is tests\_only, implementation\_only, both or none | `change.read` | `change.complete` |
| `pull_request` | a pull request whose head is an implementation revision, or that revision with only the commits that record its approval above it; its result is open | `pr.open` | `pr.opened` |
| `test_result` | the result of running tests against an implementation revision; its result is pass or fail | `tests.run` | `tests.pass` |
| `tests_change` | the record that the story's tests were written, moving the implementation to a new revision; it has no result | `tests.write` | *no claim* |

## Claims

Each claim is TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN, established from evidence by its predicate. Missing or stale evidence leaves a claim UNKNOWN, never FALSE.

| Claim | Description | True when |
|---|---|---|
| `change.complete` | the current implementation revision changes both test paths and implementation paths since the base, and its tests pass and its gate is green at that same revision | all of (`gate.green` is **TRUE**; `tests.pass` is **TRUE**; evidence `paths_changed` with result `both` about `implementation`) |
| `change.handed_over` | the harness handed the change over at the current implementation revision, saying it is complete; a new commit returns it to unknown | evidence `handover` about `implementation` |
| `change.made` | merging the current implementation revision into the base branch's tip would change its tree outside .engineering/: there is a change to publish | evidence `change_record` with result `ahead` about `implementation` |
| `ci.green` | continuous integration passes for the current implementation revision | evidence `ci_result` with result `pass` about `implementation` |
| `gate.green` | the repository's gate is green for the current implementation revision | evidence `gate_result` with result `pass` about `implementation` |
| `pr.merged` | the pull request for the current implementation revision is merged | evidence `merge_observation` with result `merged` about `implementation` |
| `pr.opened` | a pull request is open for the current implementation revision | evidence `pull_request` with result `open` about `implementation` |
| `tests.pass` | the tests pass for the current implementation revision | evidence `test_result` with result `pass` about `implementation` |
| `tests.shown_red` | the story's tests were written, and they fail at the current implementation revision; a run about an earlier revision, and a run before the tests were written, say nothing, and an edit that moves the implementation to a new revision returns the claim to unknown until the tests are run there. The order form over tests\_change with a result no such record has reads whether any tests\_change was recorded, at any revision | all of (`tests.pass` is **FALSE**; not (the first `tests_change` about `implementation` is `none`)) |

## Obligations

What must be done before a case can be complete, and what discharges it. An obligation stays open until its predicate is TRUE; its predicate being UNKNOWN does not discharge it.

| Obligation | Description | Discharged when |
|---|---|---|
| `ci.required` | continuous integration passes for the current implementation revision | `ci.green` is **TRUE** |
| `gate.required` | the repository's gate is green for the current implementation revision | `gate.green` is **TRUE** |
| `merge.required` | the pull request for the current implementation revision is merged | `pr.merged` is **TRUE** |
| `tests.required` | the tests pass for the current implementation revision | `tests.pass` is **TRUE** |

## Outcomes

The legitimate terminal interpretations of a case, and what each requires.

| Outcome | Description | Requires |
|---|---|---|
| `abandoned` | the story closed because it was explicitly abandoned | decision `explicitly_abandoned` |
| `accepted` | the story closed with its pull request merged | `pr.merged` is **TRUE** |

## Artifacts

The things whose revisions evidence is bound to.

| Artifact | Description |
|---|---|
| `implementation` | a revision of the code that realizes the plan |
| `intent` | what the story is meant to achieve |
| `plan` | the intended steps toward the intent |

## Case inputs

What a case fixes when it opens: each input takes one of the values listed, and is never UNKNOWN.

| Input | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `gate_on` | when the repository's gate runs; after the handover, it runs only on a revision whose tests pass and whose change is handed over, so once, on the revision that can be handed over, and at every revision it runs whenever asked | `after_handover`, `each_revision` |
| `tests_first` | whether the story's tests must fail before the implementation is edited; under required, the implementation is edited only while the tests, once written, fail at the current revision, or while they pass and the gate or continuous integration fails there | `optional`, `required` |
